messages.subject: AHMbook R package is now on CRAN
parts:
The AHMbook package is now available from CRAN and can be installed with install.packages("AHMbook") and updated with update.packages("AHMbook"). Or you can use the menus, but with >10,000 packages to choose from, it's quicker to type.
The packages on which AHMbook depends will automatically be downloaded and installed.

This is a new version, v.0.1.3, with the following changes:
  • Function pcount.spHDS and predict methods for unmarkedFit objects have moved to the unmarked package v.0.12 (thanks to Andy Royle); AHMbook now Depends on the new version (0.12) of unmarked.
  • Added the MHB2014, SwissSquirrels, SwissTits, Finnmark, ttdPeregrine and wagtail data sets; see the help files for ways to use these instead of .csv files with the code in the book.
  • Removed default arguments for the coordinates in map.Nmix.resi, making it more generally useful (and acceptable on CRAN).
  • Fixed: slew of warnings produced by simNmix, also dropping of dimensions with small numbers of individuals.
  • Added more examples to the help pages for simulation functions.

If you find that code from the book doesn't work as expected, check the function's help page for any recent changes.
